'''''Nova Defiant''''' was a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] in service of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was [[Ambush of the Nova Defiant|shot down]], and crashed on [[Innton II]], a colony world near the [[Triton system/Legends|Triton system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The parts that the Separatists were able to salvage were brought to a nearby cave, and were used to establish a base before the end of the Clone Wars.<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" />

Years later, a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] found the base created from the wreckage of the ''Nova Defiant'' and established a new base there named [[Defiant Core]].<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" />
